A: Group changes under at least two of the headings `### Added`, `### Changed`, `### Fixed`.
Flag incompatible changes with the exact marker `BREAKING:`.
Bullets describe the change only. No bullet may contain an @handle.
The first line must be the version heading `## [<version>] - <YYYY-MM-DD>`, for example `## [2.3.0] - 2026-03-02`.
Bullets are fragments: no bullet may end with a period.
B: The first line must be the title `# Release <version> (<Month D, YYYY>)`, for example `# Release 2.3.0 (March 2, 2026)`.
Open with a one-sentence summary on a line that starts with `Highlights: `.
Tell users what to do on a line that starts with `Upgrade: `.
Put the name of each new feature in bold with `**`.

relations.reason: Both require a specific first line: A5 requires the version heading as the first line, while B1 requires a release title as the first line. Only one can be literally first, so the output must be arranged to satisfy both, e.g., by placing one after the other.

A4 forbids any bullet from containing an @handle, while B3 requires crediting every contributor by @handle. If contributor credit is placed in a bullet, these rules cannot both be satisfied.
